BLOCKING BUG FOUND AND FIXED (outside original file inventory): running against real tmux 3.5a, the enabled/disabled subtests hung waiting for confirmed-death after tmux.KillSession. Root cause: GetPanesContext/GetPanesWithActivityContext (internal/tmux/session.go) built their `list-panes -s -t <session>` target from the bare session name. tmux does prefix/glob matching on session-name targets, so once a session is dead this either reports an unclassified "can't find window: <name>" (never recognized by ClassifyCommandError as CommandErrorSessionNotFound, so applyMonitorObservation's miss streak never advances) or — confirmed via direct repro — silently resolves to a still-live prefix-sibling session (e.g. querying dead "foo" returns live "foobar"'s real pane data) instead of erroring at all. Either way the periodic sweep would never detect an externally-killed session (tmux kill-session / crash / OOM-kill) in production — the exact primary scenario this whole feature (bd-cibu4) exists for.

Fix: added exactSessionTarget(session) = "="+session+":" in internal/tmux/session.go ("=" disables prefix/glob matching, ":" forces session-target parsing), applied at both GetPanesContext and GetPanesWithActivityContext call sites. Verified safe/identical for live sessions. Deliberately did NOT broaden ClassifyCommandError to treat "can't find window" as session-absence — that phrase also legitimately means "session exists, window index doesn't," which must stay ambiguous, not falsely confirm death.

New regression test: internal/tmux/session_test.go TestGetPanesContext_ExactSessionTarget_PrefixSiblingSurvives — creates a prefix-sibling session pair, kills only the base, proves GetPanesContext/GetPanesWithActivityContext both fail with CommandErrorSessionNotFound and the sibling is unaffected. Verified red without the fix (temporarily reverted, reproduced the exact silent-sibling-match failure) and green with it.

Also hardened Behavior 7's own closure test: each subtest now creates a prefix-distinct sentinel tmux session kept alive for the subtest's duration, so killing the target session can never be the tmux server's last session — otherwise the observation error would be the coarser CommandErrorNoServer (which also advances the miss streak) and the test could false-green without ever exercising the fix above.
